mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_answer_quality ( answer_message_id, session_id, kb_id, question, confidence, evidence_coverage, grounded, refusal, reason, create_time ) VALUES ( #{answerMessageId}, #{sessionId}, #{kbId}, #{question}, #{confidence}, #{evidenceCoverage}, #{grounded}, #{refusal}, #{reason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, f.helpful AS helpful FROM ai_answer_quality q LEFT JOIN ai_feedback f ON f.id = ( SELECT MAX(f2.id) FROM ai_feedback f2 WHERE f2.message_id = q.answer_message_id ) WHERE q.create_time >= #{from} AND (q.refusal = 1 OR q.confidence < 50 OR q.evidence_coverage < 50 OR f.helpful = 0) ORDER BY q.create_time DESC, q.id DESC
